name: Kart racing
core_loop: Hold the racing line into the corner
Break traction with a drift and charge the boost
Spend the boost on the straight and take a place
Cross the checkpoint chain and start the next lap

questions.question: How many AI racers should line up?
What shape is the first track?

acceptance.promise: Holding the handbrake through a corner slides the kart and charges a boost.
setup: Place the kart at the entry of the first corner at cruising speed
probes: Hold the drift input through the corner and sample the slip angle
Release the drift and sample speed over the next second
evidence: The slip angle rises while the drift input is held
Lateral grip drops to drift_grip during the slide
Speed after release exceeds the pre-drift speed by boost_power

acceptance.promise: A lap counts only when every checkpoint is taken in order.
setup: Set lap_count and checkpoint_count to their authored values
Start the kart on the grid
probes: Drive the full circuit and read the lap counter
Skip one checkpoint, cross the line and read the lap counter
Complete lap_count valid laps and read the race result
evidence: A complete circuit increments the lap counter by one
A circuit with a skipped checkpoint does not increment it
The race result is raised on the final valid lap
